data.name: Alhaadi
data.long_meaning: Al-Haadi is an Arabic name for boys, meaning 'The Giver' or 'The Guide'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'h-d-d', which means 'to guide' or 'to lead'. Al-Haadi is a title given to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) in the Quran, as he is considered the guide and leader for all of mankind. It is a name that carries a deep spiritual and emotional significance, as it represents the idea of being a guide and source of support and guidance for others.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies being a spiritual guide and leader, providing direction and support to those around them.
